_readme: TERM-075 / FB-A8-01. Cashtag grammars in product Python that are NOT M5's grammar
(a8Taxonomy.json cashtag.pattern). Each is a different grammar with its own owner and
ruling, recorded rather than unified: unifying them would change member-visible matching.
tests/test_a8_taxonomy.py fails BY NAME on a grammar not listed here, and on a listed one
that no longer exists (this file may only shrink). A byte-copy of M5's grammar is never
allowed here - it fails its own rail.

grammars.reason: Markdown ticker-link grammar [label]($SYM) the briefing renderer emits and strips; a link syntax, not a cashtag scan.
Answer-log parsers: markdown ticker links plus class-share cashtags in model answers; tied to the answer format, not to M5.
Answer-log parsers: markdown ticker links plus class-share cashtags in model answers; tied to the answer format, not to M5.
Discord /buzz tier-1 cashtag: mixed case, 1-6 letters, class-share suffix, left boundary; owner recall ruling 2026-09-02. Different grammar on purpose.
Notebook Ask retrieval: conservative cashtag-or-uppercase token shape over a member's question.
Notebook semantic layer: whole-token ticker shape check (anchored), not a scan of text.
Research news catalysts: mixed-case 1-6 letter cashtag used for extraction and stripping of headline text.

TERM-064's ONE ticker resolver (moved from the AI Search query parser, which now delegates; the catalyst discovery grammar was retired into it): class-share suffix plus a bare-word alternative in one pass; a resolution grammar, not M5's ingest grammar.
Voice TTS normaliser: rewrites $sym for speech; a substitution, not ticker attribution.
Wisdom segmenter: mixed-case cashtag over published Substack text (wisdom program scope).
Wisdom voice adapter: cashtag-or-uppercase token shape for publish-time checks (wisdom program scope).
Offline audit tool that measures buzz_extract's recall against a naive cashtag baseline; the naive grammar is the control.
Offline wisdom null-screen tool; a measurement grammar, not a product path.
